stem.text: A constant force $F$, acting on a car of mass $m$, moves the car up a slope through a distance $s$ at constant velocity $v$. The angle of the slope to the horizontal is $\alpha$.

stem.alt: Car drawn at the bottom of a slope and a second car at the top, with the slope angle α, a force F arrow along the slope, and distance s labelled along the slope.

stem.text: What is the ratio $\dfrac{\text{gravitational potential energy gained by car}}{\text{work done by force }F}$?
